title.zh: 获取存储空间的传输加速配置
title.en: Query the transfer acceleration configuration of a bucket

descriptions.zh:
- 只有Bucket拥有者以及被授予oss:GetBucketTransferAcceleration权限的RAM用户才能发起获取传输加速配置的请求。

- 如果Bucket未配置过传输加速，调用该接口时不返回加速配置状态。

有关传输加速的更多信息，请参见开发指南的[传输加速](~~131312~~)。
descriptions.en:
- Only the bucket owner and Resource Access Management (RAM) users who have been granted the oss:GetBucketTransferAcceleration permission can initiate a request to query the transfer acceleration configuration.

- If transfer acceleration has not been configured for the bucket, the acceleration configuration status is not returned when you invoke this operation.

For more information about transfer acceleration, see [Transfer acceleration](~~131312~~) in the developer guide.
